title: Widlar current source
description: A Widlar source generates a small, well-defined output current from a larger reference without a large resistor. The reference device is diode-connected at $I_{in}$; the output device shares the gate but has a source resistor $R_s$, so its gate-source voltage is lower than the reference's by exactly the IR drop it develops: $V_{GS,ref} - V_{GS,out} = I_{out}*R_s$. That single equation sets the output current. This sheet does not solve that loop, it CHECKS it: you pick the output current $I_{out}$ (a choice) and the resistor $R_s$, the output device is bound at that current, and a requirement rule tests whether the resulting gate-source difference actually equals $I_{out}*R_s$. Tune $I_{out}$ until it closes. That is the scope rule made visible, an explicit designer-named fixed point evaluated against the lookup tables rather than a nodal solve. Because the output runs at a lower current density than the reference, its $V_{GS}$ sits below the reference's, so the difference is positive only when $I_{out} < I_{in}$. The output device's source sits $I_{out}*R_s$ above ground (declared as $V_{SB}$; the demo table has no $V_{SB}$ axis, so it only warns).

params.name: I_in
params.note: reference current into the diode device

params.name: I_out
params.note: target output current; tune it until the Widlar fixed point closes

params.name: R_s
params.note: output-device source resistor; sets the gate-source difference I_out*R_s

params.name: M_ratio
params.note: output/reference width ratio (a unit-device multiple); usually 1

params.name: V_out
params.note: DC level of the node the source drives

params.name: fp_tol
params.note: how tightly the Widlar fixed point must close

doc.title: Reference (diode) device
doc.description: The diode-connected reference at the full input current. Its gate-source voltage is the gate rail both devices share; the output device develops a lower vgs by the R_s drop. Exposes vgs and its width.

rows.name: delta_vgs
rows.note: the actual gate-source step from the reference to the output device

rows.name: vgs_drop
rows.note: the gate-source step the resistor must produce for the chosen output current

rules.note: the output operating point must stay within the data's weak-inversion ceiling

the output node must clear the device saturation voltage plus the source-resistor drop
